Class AmwpAwareShell

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.ssh.AmwpAwareShell
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectErrorStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectInputStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectOutputStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectStreamsAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle
public class AmwpAwareShell extends Object implements org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command
The AmwpAwareShell class is the mux around ChatShell pipes. The shell is an SSH Command. It holds the inner command, the AmwpFacade, the Lamina pool, and the SSH user name. A client that sends an AMWP init frame is muxed onto channel A and channel T. A client that does not send that frame stays a raw PTY. OpenSSH stays a raw PTY. start(ChannelSession, Environment) returns before the peek, so the client can send the init frame. destroy(ChannelSession) unbinds the console and closes the mux. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#AmwpAwareShell // @aa-sdd G-07 G-18 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

      public void start(org.apache.sshd.server.channel.ChannelSession channel, org.apache.sshd.server.Environment env) throws IOException

    • handshakeThenStart

      private void handshakeThenStart()
      The handshakeThenStart method peeks for init after start(ChannelSession, Environment) has returned. A closed shell returns without starting the inner command. A null channel returns without starting the inner command. peekInit() true calls startMux(ChannelSession, Environment). A false peek wraps the stream in an AmwpInitEater and starts the inner command on the raw streams. A close that arrives during the peek returns before either start. An exception calls onExit with status 1 and the exception message when a callback is set. // @aa-sdd G-18 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

    • destroy

      public void destroy(org.apache.sshd.server.channel.ChannelSession channel)
      The destroy method closes the mux and the inner command. The closed flag is set first. AmwpFacade.bindConsole(String, AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink) is called with a null sink for this user. A keepalive timer is cancelled. The demux thread is interrupted. The channel T pipe and the peek stream are closed. A close failure is ignored. inner.destroy is called, and a failure there is ignored.
      Specified by:
      destroy in interface org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel session.

    • peekInit

      private boolean peekInit()
      The peekInit method waits for the first octet and engages the mux only for init. A null peek returns false. AmwpPeekStream.pollByte(long) waits AmwpConstants.SERVER_PEEK_MS. AmwpPeekStream.TIMEOUT returns false. A negative read returns false. A first byte that is not magic is pushed back with AmwpPeekStream.unread, and the method returns false. available() on MINA pipes is not a delivery signal. Polling that count left the init frame on ChatShell stdin as N plus U+FFFD from CRC 07 4e 91 d2. The rest of the AmwpConstants.HEADER_BYTES header is read next. A short header returns false. AmwpCodec.parse(byte[], InputStream) reads the payload. Type init writes channel A type init with flag 0. That payload is AmwpCodec.scopeAPayload(int, int, byte[], byte[]) of index 0, count 1, a null cell id, and AmwpFacade.initFacts(). The mux flag is then set, and the method returns true. Any other type returns false. Any exception returns false. // @aa-sdd G-18 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the mux engaged.

    • startMux

      private void startMux(org.apache.sshd.server.channel.ChannelSession channel, org.apache.sshd.server.Environment env) throws IOException
      The startMux method starts the inner command on mux pipes. Channel T bytes travel through a pipe whose buffer is 65536 bytes. The inner input is that pipe. The inner output is a AmwpAwareShell.ScopeTOut on the SSH output. The inner error stream stays the SSH error stream. AmwpFacade.openBantha(String) opens the session for this user. AmwpFacade.bindConsole(String, AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink) stores a sink that writes each reply with flag 0. The demux thread is named aetheris-amwp-server and is a daemon. The keepalive timer is named aetheris-amwp-server-ka and is a daemon. The timer first fires after AmwpConstants.KEEPALIVE_MS and then repeats at that same period. A ChatShell inner command sends ChatShell.sessionTokenReply() before the first client paint.
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel session.
      env - The environment is the SSH environment.
      Throws:
      IOException - The exception is a failure to start the inner command.

    • demuxLoop

      private void demuxLoop()
      The demuxLoop method reads frames until the peek ends or the shell closes. A null frame ends the loop. A keepalive frame is skipped. A channel T frame with a non-empty payload is written to the shell pipe and flushed. A channel A data frame that consoleModelFrame(AmwpFrame) accepts is not passed to the facade. Every other frame is passed to AmwpFacade.handle(String, AmwpFrame, AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink) with a sink that writes flag 0. An exception calls onExit with status 1 when the shell is still open and a callback is set.

    • consoleModelFrame

      private boolean consoleModelFrame(AmwpFrame frame)
      The consoleModelFrame method handles console frames that stay off the cell execute path. The body is AmwpCodec.stripFragPrefix(byte[]) read as UTF-8. The first line is firstLine(String). shell_mood: calls ChatShell.applyConsoleMood(String) and does not paint. shell_mood_clear: does the same. session_export: replies with this connection's Roux table and does not paint. session_replace: replaces the turns from the table and does not paint. An exact session_tokens: replies with the Roux count and does not paint. shell_model: and shell_model_set: call applyConsoleFrame(ChatShell, String, boolean). Each of those prefixes returns true even when the inner command is not a ChatShell. A true return means demuxLoop() does not pass the frame to the facade. Any other first line returns false. A false return leaves the frame for AmwpFacade.handle(String, AmwpFrame, AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink). // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-163
      Parameters:
      frame - The frame is a channel A data frame.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when this method handled the frame.

    • applyConsoleFrame

      private void applyConsoleFrame(ChatShell shell, String text, boolean set)
      The applyConsoleFrame method reads or writes the shell model, then replies. A set frame calls ChatShell.applyConsoleTarget(String). That path writes model , the console target label, and a carriage return plus newline. The VT100 line is written before the reply lock. The reply is shell_model_result: plus a newline plus ChatShell.consoleModelBody(). A null output returns without writing the reply. The reply is channel A type data with flag 0. An IOException is ignored.
      Parameters:
      shell - The shell is the console.
      text - The text is the stripped body.
      set - The flag is true for shell_model_set:.

    • writeConsoleReply

      private void writeConsoleReply(String reply)
      The writeConsoleReply method writes one channel A text reply. The text is UTF-8. A null output returns without writing. The frame is type data with flag 0. The payload is AmwpCodec.scopeAPayload(int, int, byte[], byte[]) of index 0, count 1, and a null cell id. The write is synchronized on the output. An IOException is ignored.
      Parameters:
      reply - The reply is the channel A text.

    • lineValue

      private static String lineValue(String text, String key)
      The lineValue method returns the trimmed value of one prefixed line. A null body returns empty. A null key returns empty. Each line drops one trailing carriage return. The key includes the colon. A missing line returns empty.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the body.
      key - The key is the line prefix, including the colon.

    • sendKeepalive

      private void sendKeepalive()
      The sendKeepalive method writes one keepalive frame. A shell that is not muxed returns without writing. A null output returns without writing. A closed shell returns without writing. The frame is channel A type keepalive with flag 0 and an empty payload. An IOException is ignored.
